items.title: Athlete tier theme system — Vivid (animals) vs Simple (medals)
steps: Open Settings → APP PREFERENCES → scroll to the new 🏆 TIER NAMES card. Verify two options shown side-by-side: Vivid (🐱 🦊 🐕 🦁 🦍 🐻 · Kitten → Bear) and Simple (🥉 🥈 🥇 🏆 💎 👑 · Bronze → Master). Default is Vivid.
Tap Simple. Verify it highlights gold + the request goes through (auto-save).

Return home. Verify your tier pill on the welcome card now shows the SIMPLE-theme label (e.g. Gold instead of Big Dawg). Open the tier explainer modal → verify the ATHLETE LADDER shows Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → Diamond → Master.
Open Progress → Dashboard. Verify your tier card + headline + sub-ranks all read with Simple names.
Open the leaderboard / your group. Every row's tier label should re-skin to Simple names regardless of who owns the row (theme follows the VIEWER, not the row owner).
Switch back to Vivid. Verify everything flips back to Kitten/Fox/Big Dawg/Lion/Gorilla/Bear (NO Monkey, NO Tiger anymore — those are retired in the redesign).

Trigger a tier-up milestone (or clear localStorage.ironlog-milestones-v1 and log a session). Verify the celebration overlay shows 'Reached Tier N — <name>' (with the universal tier number plus the animal name) and the right CURRENT TIER / PASSED TIER chip.
Verify the TRAINER ladder (if you're a trainer) is unchanged across themes — still Rookie / Coach / Pro / Elite.
items.notes: [2026-05-22] Shipped: schema field UserProfile.tierTheme String? ("vivid" | "simple" | null=vivid). lib/tiers.ts now exposes ATHLETE_TIER_THEMES and getAthleteTiers(theme). Athlete ladder names redesigned per @maaiz direction: Kitten → Fox → Big Dawg → Lion → Gorilla → Bear (Monkey + Tiger retired). items.title: Forgot password email flow
steps: On the login screen tap 'Forgot password?'
Enter a registered email address and submit
Verify the helper text under the input explains that nothing arriving in 5 min means check spam, then contact support
Check the inbox — a reset email should arrive within 60 seconds
Click the reset link in the email
Enter and confirm a new password
Tap 'Back to login' — verify the email you just typed is pre-filled in the username field (NOT the previous username you tried)
Log in with the new password and verify it works

items.title: Forced password reset flow
steps: In the admin panel tap '🔒 FORCE RESET' for a test user
Confirm the admin sees an alert with a TEMP password (also auto-copied to clipboard); share that with the user
Log in as that user using the TEMP password — old password should no longer work
Verify you are redirected to the must-reset-password screen, NOT the dashboard
Tap the 👁 eye toggle next to each password field — verify it reveals/hides typed characters
Enter a new password and confirm
Verify you are then taken to the dashboard normally
Confirm mustResetPassword is now false in the DB and the new password works on subsequent logins
items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Fixed: admin force-reset now generates a TEMP password (via lib/crypto.generateTempPassword), hashes + saves it, AND flips mustResetPassword=true. The plaintext temp is returned to the admin UI (auto-copied to clipboard + shown in the alert) so they can share it with the user. Previously the action only flipped the flag without changing the password, so a user who'd forgotten their old password still couldn't log in — the must-reset prompt never had a chance to fire. (qa: Amanii: 'Admin panel says reset password required but can't log in because no prompt to put new password')
[2026-05-21 ecd2e59] Fixed: must-reset screen password fields declare autocomplete="new-password" so iCloud Keychain offers to update the saved credential when the user sets their new password.
[2026-05-21 01da6f1] Fixed: must-reset screen now has eye toggle on both password fields.

items.title: Onboarding — multi-step profile creation

Step 1 — Date of birth: enter a valid DOB, tap Next
Step 2 — Gender: select one, tap Next
Step 3 — Location: select Gym / Home / Both, verify equipment list updates accordingly
Step 4 — Equipment: toggle several items, tap Next
Step 5 — Goals: select one or more goals, tap Next
Step 6 — Days per week: choose 3–5 days, tap Next
Step 7 — Height & weight: enter values, tap Next
Step 8 — Days/week + TARGET SESSION DURATION: pick 30m / 45m / 60m / 90m+ on the new chip row. Confirm 'Standard 45m' is the default selection
Tap 'Build my plan' — verify the chosen targetSessionMinutes is persisted (check UserProfile in DB)
Rebuild the plan from Settings (REBUILD MY WEEKLY PLAN) and confirm the duration chip preselects to the saved value
Verify a WorkoutPlan row is created in the DB and the home screen shows plan days

items.title: Warm-up section — auto-picked from day focus
steps: Open any saved day and start a session — verify a 'Warm-Up' section appears above the main exercises with focus-appropriate moves (push days → rower + arm circles + band pull-aparts; pull days → rower + cat-cow; legs → bike + leg swings + squat; etc.)
Verify each warm-up entry is non-trackable (no weight/reps inputs) — just a duration + tap-to-cue interaction
Open the customise screen for the same day — verify three labelled blocks: 🔥 WARM-UP, 💪 MAIN, 🧘 COOL-DOWN
Tap any warm-up or cool-down row in customise — verify a form-cue modal opens showing the icon, duration, and 2-3 technique cues. Tap the backdrop or ✕ to dismiss.

Tap '+ ADD WARM-UP' — verify a sheet opens listing the full warm-up library (8 dynamic moves + 3 cardio primers). Tap one to add — verify it appears in the warm-up section labelled '<N> CUSTOM' (replaces the AUTO label) with a REMOVE button.
Tap '+ ADD COOL-DOWN' — verify the cool-down library sheet opens (12 static stretches). Add one — same pattern.
Tap REMOVE on a custom item — verify it disappears and the section returns to AUTO mode if it was the last custom item
Reload the page — verify added custom warm-ups + cool-downs persist (saved via /api/plan PUT with kind='warmup'/'cooldown')
Start a session for the customised day — verify the saved warm-ups + cool-downs render in the session (not the auto picks anymore)

Tap the thumbnail on a warmup like 'Arm Circles' or 'Cat-Cow' — verify the FORM modal animates a REAL exercise photo (alternating between two frames), not the decorative chained-circles icon. Repeat for a cooldown like 'Child's Pose' or 'Triceps Stretch'.

For 'Doorway Chest Stretch' / 'Pigeon Pose' / 'Lying Hamstring Stretch' / 'Overhead Lat Stretch' / 'Figure-Four Stretch' / 'Leg Swings' / 'Scap Push-Ups' — these are still on the chained-circles fallback (their custom demo images need to be generated and dropped into /public/stretches/ per the plan in public/stretches/README.md). items.title: Starting a workout session
steps: From the home screen tap a plan day card
The workout preview screen shows the day title, focus, and exercise list
Tap 'Start Workout' — the session begins and the elapsed timer starts
Verify the first exercise is expanded by default

Active workout header: verify the ← Home button and the ♪ MUSIC chip are GROUPED ON THE LEFT (gap ~10px) and the destructive QUIT × button is ALONE ON THE RIGHT — no sibling buttons next to QUIT × to mis-tap. Tapping QUIT × should still fire the confirm dialog before abandoning.

items.title: Set-by-set logging (weight + reps)
steps: On the active workout view, verify each exercise card has THREE clear rows: image+name+✓ marker, status chips (only if COMPOUND/DROP SET/INJURY etc apply), then action buttons (FORM, EDIT, + DROP SET, + SUPERSET) on their own row at the bottom
Verify long names like 'Cable Flyes (Low-to-High)' or 'Cable Crossover' are NEVER truncated to 'Cabl…' or similar — they wrap to two lines if needed

Tap FORM on 'Cable Flyes (Low-to-High)' — verify the animation actually shows the low-to-high cable crossover (cables come up from low pulleys, hands sweep upward), NOT the standard mid-height crossover
Start a workout session and expand a brand-new exercise you've NEVER logged before
Verify the weight + reps inputs are pre-filled with reasonable values and a ★ SUGGESTED badge appears

Mid-workout: log a few sets, then HARD-REFRESH the browser tab (or close + reopen the PWA). Verify the home screen shows a 'session restored' banner with the elapsed time, the active workout card with set count intact, the timer counting from the original start time, and tapping the card reopens the session with ALL previously-logged sets, warmup/cooldown marks, and intensity points still present. Refresh again — verify everything still survives.
Verify a NEW 'EFFORT (optional)' row sits between the reps input and LOG SET — 10 chips labelled 1-10 with colour mapped to perceived difficulty (cool blue at the low end, fiery red at the high end)
Tap any chip — verify it highlights, and the right side shows the RPE label + RIR equivalent (e.g. '8' shows 'VERY HARD · 2 RIR')
Tap the same chip again — verify it deselects (effort is optional, can stay null)
Tap LOG SET — verify the set logs and the EFFORT chip resets for the next set
Long-press the green ✓ badge of a logged set — verify a 📝 SET NOTE modal opens with a textarea (240 char limit)
Type a note, tap ✓ SAVE NOTE — verify the badge gets a small amber dot in the top-right corner indicating an attached note
Long-press the same badge again — verify the modal reopens with the previously-saved note text
Tap CLEAR in the modal — verify the dot disappears
Verify the yellow ⟳ PAIR header button is GONE — replaced by the per-exercise + SUPERSET picker which is strictly more powerful

On reload, the restore effect rehydrates all three plus the start time, shows a 'session restored' overlay summarising elapsed time + set count, and the timer keeps counting from the original start. Added a beforeunload guard that fires the browser's native 'Leave site?' prompt while a session is active. (Reported by @maaiz — user lost a session mid-workout to a refresh.)
[2026-05-22] Fixed: active workout exercise row no longer truncates long names — image+name+✓ on top row, status chips on their own conditional row, action buttons (FORM/EDIT/+ DROP SET/+ SUPERSET) on a dedicated wrap row underneath. items.title: Rest timer — countdown, beep, notification
steps: Complete a set — the rest timer should auto-start with the exercise's rest duration
Verify the countdown ticks down accurately in real time
Lock the phone / switch to another app for 20 s, then return — timer should still show correct remaining time
When the timer reaches 0: verify audible beep (double tone), vibration on mobile, and a push notification titled 'IRONLOG' saying rest is over
CRUCIAL: when the timer ends, the workout UI should STAY at the exercise you were on (NOT scroll to the top)
While the current exercise still has incomplete sets, finishing rest should keep you on it — no jumping away mid-exercise
Complete all sets of an exercise — once rest ends, the next incomplete exercise should auto-expand automatically (no toggle, this is unconditional)
Manually tap a different exercise — from then on auto-advance continues through its sets, then jumps to whatever is systematically next
Tap 'Skip' — timer should clear immediately
items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Fixed per user feedback: removed the opt-in 'Auto-advance after rest' Settings toggle. Behaviour is now unconditional — stay on current exercise while incomplete sets remain, then auto-advance to the next incomplete exercise once all sets are done (or the user manually skips/picks another). The ⚙ WORKOUT BEHAVIOUR card in Settings was deleted along with the localStorage key.
[2026-05-21] Fixed: scroll-jump-to-top bug after rest ends. Root cause: the body-scroll-lock useEffect's cleanup function cleared document.body.style.top before the new effect body could read it to restore scrollY. Now stashed in a useRef.
Notification requires notification permission to be granted. Test with service worker active.

items.title: Supersets — paired exercises in-session

items.title: Scoring rewards rest days + caps overtraining
steps: Set profile.daysPerWeek to 4. Train EXACTLY 4 distinct days a week for 4 weeks. Open Progress → Dashboard and confirm your Consistency sub-rank reads high (~85+) — the adherence dimension is at 100%.

Same user, train 7 days/week for 4 weeks (overtrain). Verify Consistency DROPS — adherence is now ~150% which the curve scores around 25-50 points. Detail line should read '... (over target — rest!)'.
Train 0 days for 4 weeks. Verify Consistency drops to whatever lifetime-sessions alone scores (~40-50% of previous if you had a year of training).
Verify the streak component still exists but is heavily de-weighted (10% of consistency) — a 14-day streak alone won't max consistency anymore.
Verify the Volume sub-rank is unchanged in its formula (still log curve to 100k kg-reps midpoint) — going harder still earns volume points, but the headline is dragged by consistency adherence.
Switch profile.daysPerWeek to 6 → adherence target rescales to 24 sessions in 4 weeks. Verify the detail line updates.
items.notes: [2026-05-22] Shipped: replaced 0.6*sessions + 0.4*streak with 0.5*sessions + 0.4*adherence + 0.1*streak in the consistency sub-rank. Adherence peaks at 100% of weekly target (daysPerWeek * 4 over 4 weeks) and DROPS past that: 150% scores 50, 200% scores 0. Rest days now FEED the score by leaving the user closer to target. Server-side stats compute sessionsLast4Weeks (distinct days) + fetches daysPerWeek from UserProfile to pipe into computeAthleteTier; client memo does the same. (Reported by @maaiz: 'Points should be fair to reward sufficient rest days and minimise reward for going too hard'.)
